items.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: Yeah, I see him occasionally. He's still working too. Works for the bank. Works for the Whitney bank.

ctx.x: Who's band was that? Do you remember whose job it was? Eddie Dawson. Oh, Eddie Dawson. We'll see him soon, very soon.
Yeah, I see him occasionally. He's still working too. Works for the bank. Works for the Whitney bank.
Willie got in the Humboldt one night. Dead with him ass. And he went out. He went off the job. Better come out. Walk across the street, they saw George. And they hired George. George Bucket.
